goal: Test whether a low-opacity local plate-count and thagomizer seed over the current relock candidate can be naturalized by the SDXL refiner.

experiments.finding: Rejected before review export. The added plate row sat too high and read as a detached translucent guide arc rather than natural embedded dorsal plates.

experiments.type: lower-opacity local plate-count and thagomizer overlay
experiments.finding: Still rejected. The plate count cue is clearer, but the added plates remain translucent and detached from the back. The four-spike thagomizer is visible only as a graphic guide.

experiments.type: SDXL refiner i2i over v2a/v2b at denoise 0.18 and 0.28
experiments.finding: Rejected. The refiner preserved the translucent guide artifacts and introduced face/body drift instead of turning the overlays into natural bony plates and tail spikes.

decision.reason: Local translucent guide overlays plus low-denoise refiner are not enough to create a usable Stegosaurus candidate. The current app-first relock candidate remains better.
decision.nextRoute: Do not continue with translucent overlay seeds. Build a focused stegosaurian plate/thagomizer LoRA or a cleaner opaque synthetic training/control set where plate count and thagomizer are already natural-looking before refiner passes.
